problem_statement: The SRP client's DNS Update message-ID handling is incorrect. When the client retries an Update that has not changed, it should keep sending the same message ID so the server can match the response to the original request; instead the client assigns a new ID to each retry. Likewise, when the client's registered services change, a new Update must carry a fresh message ID, and a delayed response arriving for an older Update must be ignored in favor of the latest one. As a result, a delayed server response can be accepted for a stale Update (registering the client when it should remain unregistered) or rejected for a still-current Update.
